surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involved in the PEALD process using TAIMA TA and H2 plasma were not explicitly detailed in the text. However, it was mentioned that the use of H2 plasma resulted in the formation of cubic-TaN phases and reduced electrical resistivity, indicating a surface reaction that leads to the formation of TaN with improved crystallinity.
evidence: The text states: 'the use of H2 plasma resulted in moderate electrical resistivity as well as cubic-TaN phases, we investigated the effect of the use of H2 plasma on the microstructural evolution, electrical properties, and composition of the films.'
